evidence_requests.question: Screen the current partition for unsupported internal splits and weak pair boundaries.
Is the current membership of K3_C0001 represented as a distinguishable unit in the multimodal patient geometry?
Is the current membership of K3_C0002 represented as a distinguishable unit in the multimodal patient geometry?
Is the current membership of K3_C0003 represented as a distinguishable unit in the multimodal patient geometry?
Does K3_C0001 show a coherent and interpretable biological phenotype or molecular program relative to the appropriate comparison population?
Does K3_C0002 show a coherent and interpretable biological phenotype or molecular program relative to the appropriate comparison population?
Does K3_C0003 show a coherent and interpretable biological phenotype or molecular program relative to the appropriate comparison population?
Do the current labels of K3_C0002 and K3_C0003 form a distinguishable boundary in the multimodal patient geometry, or is their boundary not represented?

actions.reason: K3_C0001 has a coherent, interpretable immune/inflammatory identity (allograft rejection, interferon alpha/gamma, IL6-JAK-STAT3, NES ~2.1-2.6, fdr_q 0.001) per the set-scope RNA enrichment report. Its current membership is weakly but consistently represented in native geometries (positive CT/RNA/WSI silhouettes with within-set below between-set distances), and its boundaries against both K3_C0002 and K3_C0003 are directionally represented in the pair-scope concordance reports (positive silhouettes in all four modalities for both pairs). The pair structural diagnostic for K3_C0001-K3_C0003 shows a near-zero boundary silhouette and a single-cluster-dominated union, but that weak boundary is not sufficient to justify merge, and the union's single-cluster profile is not evidence against merge; the directionally opposite immune-high vs immune-low/TGF-beta-WNT phenotypes weigh against one-unit representation. No material technical alternative has been established, and no supported internal subdivision is present. Identity and independent membership are therefore positively supported.

K3_C0002 has a coherent, interpretable metabolic/mitochondrial and secretory identity (oxidative phosphorylation, fatty-acid metabolism, adipogenesis, mTORC1, protein secretion, NES ~1.9-2.9, fdr_q 0.001) per the set-scope RNA enrichment report, directionally distinct from the immune-high K3_C0001. Its current membership is weakly but consistently represented in all four native geometries (positive silhouettes with within-set below between-set distances), and its boundaries against K3_C0001 and K3_C0003 are directionally represented in the pair-scope concordance reports (positive silhouettes in all four modalities for both pairs). No material technical alternative has been established, and no supported internal subdivision is present. Identity and independent membership are therefore positively supported.

K3_C0003 has a coherent, interpretable immune-low/TGF-beta-WNT identity (negative immune and oxidative-phosphorylation enrichment, positive TGF-beta and WNT/beta-catenin, fdr_q 0.001-0.006) per the set-scope RNA enrichment report, with a directionally ccRCC-like but multiplicity-attenuated mutational profile (PBRM1/VHL enrichment, BAP1 depletion, none surviving adjustment) per the WXS report. Its current membership is weakly represented in native geometries (only RNA shows a small positive silhouette; CT/WSI/WXS are near zero), and its boundaries against K3_C0001 and K3_C0003's neighbors are directionally represented in the pair-scope concordance reports (positive silhouettes in all four modalities for both pairs). The pair structural diagnostic for K3_C0001-K3_C0003 shows a near-zero boundary silhouette and a single-cluster-dominated union, but that weak boundary is not sufficient to justify merge, and the union's single-cluster profile is not evidence against merge; the directionally opposite immune-high vs immune-low/TGF-beta-WNT phenotypes weigh against one-unit representation. No material technical alternative has been established, and no supported internal subdivision is present. Identity and independent membership are therefore positively supported.
